proposed_construct: Neutralization of respiratory syncytial virus by binding the prefusion F glycoprotein and preventing fusion of the viral envelope with the host-cell membrane
proposed_objective: Connect antibody binding to the prefusion RSV F protein with blockade of membrane fusion and viral entry.

proposed_construct: Inhibition of activated factor XII by a monoclonal antibody, reducing contact-system activation and downstream kallikrein-bradykinin generation
proposed_objective: Link factor XIIa inhibition to reduced kallikrein activation and bradykinin generation while distinguishing it from direct kallikrein and bradykinin-receptor blockade.

proposed_construct: Dual phosphodiesterase 3 and phosphodiesterase 4 inhibition increasing cyclic nucleotide signaling in airway cells
proposed_objective: Differentiate dual PDE3/PDE4 inhibition from beta2-agonism, muscarinic antagonism, and selective PDE4 inhibition.

proposed_construct: Neutralization of tissue factor pathway inhibitor to increase tissue-factor-initiated thrombin generation in hemophilia
proposed_objective: Connect TFPI inhibition with restoration of thrombin generation through the extrinsic coagulation pathway.

proposed_construct: Antagonism of interleukin-31 receptor alpha signaling to reduce IL-31-mediated sensory-neuron and inflammatory signaling
proposed_objective: Differentiate IL-31 receptor blockade from IL-4/IL-13, JAK, and histamine signaling in pruritic inflammatory disease.

proposed_construct: Antagonism of the interleukin-36 receptor, blocking IL-36-dependent inflammatory signaling
proposed_objective: Recognize IL-36 receptor blockade as distinct from IL-17, IL-23, TNF, and JAK pathway inhibition.

proposed_construct: Biparatopic HER2-directed antibody binding two non-overlapping extracellular HER2 epitopes and promoting receptor internalization and immune-mediated cytotoxicity
proposed_objective: Distinguish biparatopic dual-epitope HER2 engagement from single-epitope HER2 blockade and small-molecule kinase inhibition.

proposed_construct: Bispecific HER2-HER3 binding that blocks neuregulin-1-dependent HER2-HER3 signaling in NRG1-fusion cancers
proposed_objective: Connect NRG1 fusion signaling with HER2-HER3 heterodimer dependence and pharmacologic blockade by a bispecific antibody.

proposed_construct: Autologous T cells engineered with an HLA-A*02-restricted T-cell receptor that recognizes a MAGE-A4 peptide presented by tumor cells
proposed_objective: Differentiate engineered T-cell receptor recognition of intracellular tumor antigen peptide-MHC from CAR recognition of an intact surface antigen.

proposed_construct: Interleukin-15 superagonist complex signaling through IL-2/IL-15 receptor beta and common gamma chains to expand and activate natural killer and CD8 T cells
proposed_objective: Connect IL-15 receptor signaling with NK-cell and CD8 T-cell expansion while distinguishing it from IL-2 receptor alpha-dependent signaling.

proposed_construct: Bispecific DLL3-CD3 T-cell engagement that redirects cytotoxic T cells toward DLL3-expressing tumor cells
proposed_objective: Recognize a DLL3-directed T-cell engager and distinguish it from antibody-drug conjugates and checkpoint blockade.

proposed_construct: Allosteric MEK1 and MEK2 inhibition suppressing ERK phosphorylation downstream of activated RAS-RAF signaling
proposed_objective: Locate MEK1/2 within the RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade and distinguish MEK inhibition from RAF and ERK inhibition.
